title: Heading to Node
description: Heading to Node is a mapping ability in the Dynamic Markdown & Schema Mind-Maps database. Turns every markdown heading into a mind-map node at the matching depth. Headings H1–H6 become nodes at depths 0–5; paragraphs attach as leaf notes under their heading. It takes markdown source and produces node tree. Tunable parameters: depth = heading level − 1. Guarantee: no heading is ever dropped.

fields.mechanism: Headings H1–H6 become nodes at depths 0–5; paragraphs attach as leaf notes under their heading.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Schema to Graph
description: Schema to Graph is a mapping ability in the Dynamic Markdown & Schema Mind-Maps database. Renders a JSON schema as an explorable node graph. Each schema property becomes a node; required properties get a solid border and types get color codes. It takes JSON schema and produces schema graph. Tunable parameters: nesting unlimited. Guarantee: every property appears exactly once.

fields.mechanism: Each schema property becomes a node; required properties get a solid border and types get color codes.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Live Re-Fold
description: Live Re-Fold is a mapping ability in the Dynamic Markdown & Schema Mind-Maps database. Re-folds the map instantly when the source document changes. The document is re-parsed on save and the tree is diffed; only changed branches re-render. It takes edited document and produces updated map. Tunable parameters: diff under 100 ms. Guarantee: fold states survive re-parsing.

fields.mechanism: The document is re-parsed on save and the tree is diffed; only changed branches re-render.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Bidirectional Editing
description: Bidirectional Editing is a mapping ability in the Dynamic Markdown & Schema Mind-Maps database. Edits made on the map write back into the source markdown. Node text edits are mapped back to their source lines; the document updates on blur. It takes map edits and produces updated markdown. Tunable parameters: round-trip lossless. Guarantee: the source never gains duplicate lines.

fields.mechanism: Node text edits are mapped back to their source lines; the document updates on blur.
fields.guarantees: the source never gains duplicate lines

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Tag Constellations
description: Tag Constellations is a mapping ability in the Dynamic Markdown & Schema Mind-Maps database. Groups nodes by shared tags into visible constellations. Tags are collected across nodes; each tag draws a soft halo around its member nodes. It takes node tags and produces tag halos. Tunable parameters: halo per tag. Guarantee: untagged nodes never join a halo.

fields.mechanism: Tags are collected across nodes; each tag draws a soft halo around its member nodes.
fields.guarantees: untagged nodes never join a halo

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Link Weaving
description: Link Weaving is a mapping ability in the Dynamic Markdown & Schema Mind-Maps database. Draws cross-links for markdown links between distant branches. Inline links become curved edges between their source and target nodes. It takes markdown links and produces cross edges. Tunable parameters: curved, labeled. Guarantee: broken links render dashed red.

fields.mechanism: Inline links become curved edges between their source and target nodes.

console.log('Headings '+headings+' -> '+nodes+' map nodes');

title: Focus Branch Isolation
description: Focus Branch Isolation is a mapping ability in the Dynamic Markdown & Schema Mind-Maps database. Isolates one branch so the user can work without the rest of the map. Isolation hides all nodes outside the chosen subtree and shows a breadcrumb back out. It takes chosen node and produces isolated view. Tunable parameters: breadcrumb always visible. Guarantee: isolation never deletes hidden nodes.

fields.mechanism: Isolation hides all nodes outside the chosen subtree and shows a breadcrumb back out.

title: Depth Coloring
description: Depth Coloring is a mapping ability in the Dynamic Markdown & Schema Mind-Maps database. Colors nodes by depth so the hierarchy reads at a glance. Depth maps to a hue ramp; the legend stays fixed so colors mean the same thing everywhere. It takes node depths and produces colored map. Tunable parameters: 6-step ramp. Guarantee: depth 0 is always the same color.

fields.mechanism: Depth maps to a hue ramp; the legend stays fixed so colors mean the same thing everywhere.
fields.guarantees: depth 0 is always the same color

title: Search and Zoom
description: Search and Zoom is a mapping ability in the Dynamic Markdown & Schema Mind-Maps database. Finds a node by text and flies the camera to it. Matches highlight in place; choosing one animates the viewport to center it. It takes search text and produces camera flight. Tunable parameters: animation 600 ms. Guarantee: search never moves nodes.

title: Collapse Memory
description: Collapse Memory is a mapping ability in the Dynamic Markdown & Schema Mind-Maps database. Remembers which branches were folded between sessions. Fold states are stored per document hash; reopening restores the exact fold pattern. It takes fold states and produces restored view. Tunable parameters: keyed by content hash. Guarantee: a changed document never gets stale folds.

fields.mechanism: Fold states are stored per document hash; reopening restores the exact fold pattern.
fields.guarantees: a changed document never gets stale folds

title: Export to Outline
description: Export to Outline is a mapping ability in the Dynamic Markdown & Schema Mind-Maps database. Exports the current map back to a clean indented outline. The tree walks depth-first and emits bullets with the same nesting the map shows. It takes map state and produces markdown outline. Tunable parameters: round-trip stable. Guarantee: export always matches the visible tree.

fields.mechanism: The tree walks depth-first and emits bullets with the same nesting the map shows.
fields.guarantees: export always matches the visible tree

demo.code:
function fold(ids){return ids.filter(function(id,i){return i%2===0;});}
console.log('Visible after fold: '+JSON.stringify(fold([1,2,3,4,5])));

title: Multi-Document Map
description: Multi-Document Map is a mapping ability in the Dynamic Markdown & Schema Mind-Maps database. Merges several documents into one shared mind-map. Each document becomes a top-level branch under a root node; shared tags still draw halos across documents. It takes document set and produces merged map. Tunable parameters: one branch per doc. Guarantee: documents never interleave.

fields.mechanism: Each document becomes a top-level branch under a root node; shared tags still draw halos across documents.

title: Change Heat
description: Change Heat is a mapping ability in the Dynamic Markdown & Schema Mind-Maps database. Colors recently edited nodes warm so fresh work stands out. Edit timestamps decay over 24 hours; warmth is the recency score mapped to color. It takes edit log and produces heat overlay. Tunable parameters: half-life 6 h. Guarantee: edits older than 48 h never glow.

title: Keyboard Navigation
description: Keyboard Navigation is a mapping ability in the Dynamic Markdown & Schema Mind-Maps database. Navigates the entire map without a mouse. Arrow keys move between siblings and levels; Enter edits and Tab indents the node. It takes map state and produces keyboard control. Tunable parameters: full parity with mouse. Guarantee: every mouse action has a key equivalent.
